scope: Tokenizer-level dry run over authored harmful probes and declining base answers already in the clone: per-step suppression/forced-replacement plan and table reachability. No generation, no weights, no logits; the decode driver applies these biases in the next stage.
method: Token paths come from a live llama-server POST /tokenize (add_special=false, parse_special=false); no completion request is made, no weights or logits are read. Each table form is tokenized in both contexts (bare at the start of a path, and with the leading space it carries in running text). An occurrence of a context sequence at steps s..e means the completing token e would carry logit_bias -100, and a replacement, when the table gives one, would be forced at e with +100 on its first token (leading space included, because it follows an emitted token). rules_that_fired is the set of entries with at least one occurrence. A rule is reachable only when at least one context both round-trips through the artifact vocabulary and occurs in a carrier sentence; a form that matches only in isolation cannot fire in running text and fails the run. Coverage tokenizes every declining base answer and asks whether any table context occurs in that answer; opener coverage restricts the occurrence to start before step 8. The prompt plan runs the same matcher over the prompt token path; those positions are descriptive because prompt tokens are not generated, and the reference plan (an authored declining continuation on each probe) is the decode-step schedule the driver would follow if the model emitted that text.

base_answers.note: each source is a base arm of an in-clone generation wave; predictions for other arms live in sibling directories and are not base answers

served.note: /tokenize is the only inference endpoint used.
